subject: creating facets based on aggregate grouping

messages.author: 6d91a9061453aa7b
messages.subject: creating facets based on aggregate grouping
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm would like to facet my data with respect to binned time points
(defined in my dataset, e.g. 0-2 s is in time point bin 1). However, I
would like the facets to include not only the current time point bin,
but also all the bins preceding it. I've included an example of a
method that creates multiple ggplots to simulate this. Basically I'd
like to look at the evolution of the data over time, and not just the
positional data at a given time point. I hope my example makes this
clear. Is there a way in ggplot2 to do this OR is there a clever way
to define factors in my dataset to use ggplot2 faceting as is (short
of repeating all the previous data for the current timepoint). Perhaps
even editing the dataset as it's being plotted by ggplot2 (changing
time point bin for previous data to the current bin number)? I'm just
throwing out ideas.

Faisal


Example:

$ cat test-data.txt
id time timebin x y
0 1.0 1 1.0 2.4
0 2.0 1 1.7 3.5
0 3.0 2 0.8 2.1
0 4.0 2 0.1 3.4
1 1.0 1 3.2 1.5
1 2.0 1 2.5 2.1
2 1.0 1 1.9 3.2
2 2.0 1 0.1 1.2
2 3.0 2 0.5 0.2
2 4.0 2 1.2 0.7

$ cat test-facet.R
library(ggExtra)
posn<-read.table("test-data.txt",header=T)
pp<-vector("list",length(unique(posn$timebin)))
for (i in unique(posn$timebin)) {
posnsub<-subset(posn,timebin<i+1)
pptemp<-ggplot(posnsub)
pptemp<-pptemp+geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y,group=factor(id)))
pptemp<-pptemp+scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,4))+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,4))+opts(title=paste("bin",i,sep="
"))
pp[[i]]=pptemp
}
pdf(file="pxy.pdf",width=6,height=4.5)
arrange(pp[[1]],pp[[2]],nrow=1)
dev.off()

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: creating facets based on aggregate grouping
parts:
Hi Faisal,

There's currently no way to do this except by duplicating your data.
Each observation in the input data must occur in one and only one
facet.

Hadley
